caption:
Stephen Hawking Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA00695049, the June 2015 email-address request.

June 23, 2015: Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff writes to Epstein, "Do you want me to give Stephen Hawking's email address to Steven Pinker?" Forwarded inside the thread: physicist Lawrence Krauss handing it over — "I don't normally give out email addresses, even to friends... but I guess since Jeffrey flew stephen on a plane it is ok."

What Epstein wanted Hawking's email for, the document never says. The address is obscured in the release — the reel quotes the request, never the address.

Jeff Bezos Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA00759004, the May 2010 Edge list.

May 11, 2010: John Brockman's "It was Nassim!!" thread — and the To field is the whole artifact: Jeff Bezos; Sergey Brin; George Church; Jeffrey Epstein; Elon Musk; Larry Page; Pierre Omidyar; Jeff Skoll; Jimmy Wales...

One email, one circle. Not a meeting, not a deal — a shared mailing list. The document proves proximity, nothing more.

Ghislaine Maxwell Jeffrey Epstein — EFTA02332402, her own email.

September 6, 2002: James Attaway is traveling to Palm Beach to meet Jeffrey Epstein. The person who re-routes his trip is Ghislaine Maxwell, writing as "G. Max": "James is there any chance of changing the schedule again - instead of coming in on Mon can you come to Palm Beach on Sunday. Can you let me know so that this can be organized ASAP. My new Asst is called Helen. Thank you — G" His reply the same evening: no problem — her assistant has him arriving West Palm Beach 9:41am Sunday, "a driver will be waiting to pick me up."

A second document: the seized Palm Beach household binder (EFTA00007893) lists "Mr. Jeffrey Epstein / Ms Ghislaine Maxwell" as the two principals at every property — New York, Palm Beach, Zorro Ranch, Little St. James, Paris, London.

That's the documented Maxwell — the operating officer of the household, in her own hand. What she was convicted of, a jury decided in 2021. These documents show how the house ran.
